fixed_hypothesis.question: Can concentrating executable exposure in an empty portfolio while discounting entries stacked on existing exposure increase conservative profit without losing the paired-month pragmatic DD and temporal envelope?

causal_execution.state: number of candidate-admitted positions still open immediately before the source birth
causal_execution.volume: the exact source executable steps, which already embed the frozen daily stressed-balance ladder and paired-month component weight, times the occupancy factor with positive MathRound semantics to 0.01 lot steps
causal_execution.risk: source stop-risk per lot scaled to candidate steps; admitted open planned risk must stay within 18% of conservative candidate capital plus $0.01
causal_execution.opportunities: the 1,428 fixed source births only; a candidate skip does not synthesize a replacement or reopen any source risk skip
causal_execution.exits: fixed source natural close and cost path scaled by candidate executable volume
causal_execution.control: factors 1/1 must exactly reproduce every source volume, admission and selection economic total
causal_execution.proxy_limit: fixed-source-step closed-path screen only; it does not recreate volume-ladder feedback after candidate P/L diverges and has no native fill, open-equity DD, margin or skipped-opportunity authority

selection_funnel.profit_reserve: subtract the maximum prior adverse proxy overstatement $255.6802/$234.2145 plus a new $25 from candidate actual/stressed before requiring strict improvement over +$5,786.63/+$5,477.524
selection_funnel.temporal: actual/stressed capital and all four selection epochs must stay positive
selection_funnel.drawdown: budget native anchor 20.256887565% plus any adverse candidate raw-DD delta versus the exact control plus 0.25 points; require <=21.2% and report the nominal 20% line separately
selection_funnel.winner: rank only complete selection-eligible noncontrol paths by conservative stressed net, conservative actual net, lower budgeted DD, smaller factor departure and deterministic factor tie-breaks

conditional_forward.july: actual at least -$2 and stressed at least -$3

stop_rules: Run one formal source-free process after the input, config, script, receipt and declaration are frozen.
Correct input, parser, design or implementation faults without economic judgment and without a retry cap.
If selection has no eligible noncontrol path, do not read candidate forward outcomes and close without MT5.
If the deterministic selection winner fails any forward gate, close without MT5 and without another occupancy path.
If all gates pass, freeze exactly one candidate for one separately owned non-Master MT5 selection family.
Do not continue into an adjacent factor, component, direction, symbol, epoch, session, risk cap, admission replacement, partial-fill or exit rescue.
